docs.description: Hand-written tool with a repeatable discriminated union whose sub-commands include two with the same id (the c3d c2d/c3d/c4d shape: two byte-identical -orient sub-commands). The duplicate-tagged variant is deduplicated so each emitter (cargs + validate) dispatches one branch per @type; a second branch is unreachable and a mypy --strict comparison-overlap (the tag is narrowed away by the first).
